name: SegmentedControl
description: A horizontal set of options where one is always selected, functioning as a compact alternative to tabs. Keyboard navigation follows the ARIA radiogroup pattern.

keyboardInteraction: Home — move focus to first segment
End — move focus to last segment
notes: Each segment is a button with role="radio" and aria-checked for the active state.
Only the active segment has tabIndex=0; inactive segments have tabIndex=-1.
Arrow keys wrap around from last to first and vice versa.
When disabled, all segments are disabled and pointer-events are removed.

options.description: Array of segment options. Each option provides a visible label and a unique id.

activeId.description: The id of the currently active segment. This is a controlled prop.

onChange.description: Called when the user activates a segment. Receives the segment id.

size.description: Size of the control, matching Button size scale (mini=28, compact=36, default=48, large=56).

fullWidth.description: Stretches the control to fill its container width. Each segment gets equal width.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Use SegmentedControl for switching between views or filtering content.
Keep the number of options between 2 and 5.
Ensure one option is always active — this is not a toggle.
dont: Do not use for form input — use RadioGroup instead.
Do not use for navigation between pages — use Tabs instead.
Do not use more than 5 options — consider a Select for larger sets.
Do not leave the control without a selected option.
